hooks.command: f=".claude/.teach-reminder-count"; c=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); c=$((c+1)); echo "$c" > "$f"; if [ $((c % 3)) -eq 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"[Teaching reminder] %d technical operations (Bash/Edit/Write) in a row. This project requires a brief Japanese explanation of WHY and WHAT-is-happening after technical steps, not just results. If you already explained recently, a short line is enough -- just do not skip it silently."}}' "$c"; fi
